card.name: Small words before drug-class terms
card.fires_on: Short words like 'short', 'of', 'an' or a space that come right before a drug-class or drug-name term in dosing text. Often 'short' in 'short-acting opioids'.

modes.label: short before -acting
modes.description: The word 'short' before '-acting opioids' in opioid-free interval advice.
modes.example: An opioid-free interval of a minimum of 7 to 10 days is recommended for patients previously dependent on<< short>>-acting opioids.
